name: property-filter
purpose: One field that filters a collection by properties and free text, after Cloudscape's property filter. Typing suggests a property, then an operator, then a value, and each choice becomes a removable token (`Status = Active`); text typed without a property becomes a free-text token. Two or more tokens combine with Match all (and) or Match any (or). It edits a `PropertyFilterQuery` and never filters anything itself: `useCollection` (or the server) applies the query, and `propertyFilterProps` binds the query, the properties and the match count in one `v-bind`.
useWhen: A list or table that people narrow by several fields at once (status, region, owner) and by text.
Any collection driven by `useCollection`, client or server mode.
Filters that must survive a reload or a shared link: the query serializes into the URL through `useCollection`.
avoidWhen: A single text search over a short list → use `input` bound to `filterProps`.
A few fixed choices always on screen → use `toggle-group` or `chip` filters.
A structured filter builder with its own panel inside a table toolbar → use `table-filter`.
related: use-collection` — applies the query; `propertyFilterProps` is the binding.
table` — the collection it usually filters.
cards` — the card form of a collection.
collection-preferences` — the panel that sits beside it in the controls row.
bestPractices: Give every property with a closed set of values its `options`, so values are suggested and tokens print labels.
Set `type: 'number'` or `type: 'date'` on ordered properties to offer `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`.
Bind `totalCount` so people hear how many items match after each change.
Name the field after the collection (`aria-label="Filter resources"`).

props.name: query
props.doc: The tokens and how they combine. Supports v-model:query.

props.name: properties
props.doc: Properties the suggestions offer, with their operators and values.

props.name: totalCount
props.doc: Items that match the query, announced next to the tokens. Hidden when unset.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder of the field. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the field. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: freeText
props.doc: Accepts typed text with no property as a free-text token.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the field and the tokens.

events.name: update:query
events.notes: A token was added or removed, the operation changed, or all cleared.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import PropertyFilter from '@aziontech/webkit/property-filter'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const properties = [
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      options: [{ value: 'Active' }, { value: 'Inactive' }, { value: 'Degraded' }]
    },
    {
      key: 'region',
      label: 'Region',
      options: [{ value: 'sa-east' }, { value: 'us-east' }, { value: 'eu-west' }]
    },
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
    { key: 'requests', label: 'Requests', type: 'number' }
  ]

  const query = ref({
    tokens: [{ propertyKey: 'status', operator: '=', value: 'Active' }],
    operation: 'and'
  })
</script>

<template>
  <PropertyFilter
    v-model:query="query"
    :properties="properties"
    :total-count="12"
  />
</template>
